users.persona: A researcher who publishes clear explanations for busy colleagues.

preferences.default: Restrained presentation, concrete examples, plain language, explicit uncertainty.
preferences.writing: Start with a concrete example, then explain the principle. Avoid sales language.
preferences.websites: Generous spacing, descriptive headings, muted colors, no unnecessary animation.

users.feedback_style: Give at most two specific improvements per review. Explain why when asked.

users.persona: An educator making science approachable for curious newcomers.

preferences.default: Playful, inviting presentation with concrete examples and accurate claims.
preferences.writing: Use a vivid analogy and a friendly tone, then explain where the analogy breaks down.
preferences.websites: Warm colors, strong visual hierarchy, a clear invitation to try something.

users.feedback_style: Give at most two specific improvements per review. Explain why when asked.
